non-blocking: the checkpoint dates the named-file gate to 5249ae1bc9 while logs/head-named-file.log:1 records job 1319618 running at 252b99e4429, and the delivered head is a later docs-only commit that no gate was run over.

non-blocking: _released_claim restates the still-claims predicate that _claim_collision at holds.py:508 and _refreshed_claim at holds.py:536 own, and drops their _claim_paths_share test, so a stored refusal whose path the project treats as a shared source file is never retired and the stale record this node repairs survives on that class.

non-blocking: the release test runs after the pass has already searched the fleet for a binding claim, so a pass that finds the holder claiming a different one of the request's paths writes the declined back-off over its own fresh held-on-claim record, replacing the holder-naming reason with one that names nobody.

non-blocking: the assertions added at line 299 and line 301 compare the record against CLAIMED_PATH, the same constant the case hands in as both the request's and the holder's write path, so they cannot distinguish the requested path from the claimed one and the cause's guard is the verdict assertion at line 298.
